description: BBS STEM Agriculture aims to revolutionize agriculture by using NASA data to adapt farming to extreme environments. Our project focuses on simulating the conditions of the Moon and Mars and recreating them in a greenhouse in Al Abdali, Kuwait.
summary:
Future Farming is a free website that helps farmers choose their crop rotations as the climate changes over the years.

We developed was a decision support tool, in which the farmers enter their location and the site pulls NASA POWER data for the exact field, including, highs and lows of the temperatures year round, soil moisture, and average rainfall, which covers long term averages and data across the last 45 days. Our simulator, built crop-water methods, tests a two-year crop plant simulator, which shows the progress of the farm developing across the next few years, it then shows the end result including the priorities and what if's that the farmers have.

Farming gives us the most consumed foods across the globe, but its not as easy as just planting seeds and watering them, farmers face lots of difficulties and Future Farming is built to combat just that. With Future Farming, farmers will be able to develop their crops more efficiently and prevent crop failure which could stop famine.
details:
Our project acts as a support tool to help farmers plan their crop rotations using simulations and data from NASA.

It benefits society as a whole, as it allows farmers to plan ahead, preventing famine, and keeping the economy stable.

Our intention was to create a simple website for farmers who aren't exactly tech savvy, as they can easily understand the challenges that their farms will face and can easily input the conditions and priorities of the farm.

We used Claude Codex to develop the website, (Netlify, Groq, Cloudflare to implement the SI chatbot into our website) and HTML as the coding language.

In terms of creativity, we used visual simulations to improve the user's understanding of their farm's growth, and we added two chatbots impersonating real people in our team instead of just being mindless robots.

Our team was sure to consider the easy accessibility for the user experience
